name: Occlusion Frustums
definition: A novel approach to empty space leaping that reduces costly volume texture fetches during ray traversal by generating an optimized proxy geometry based on occlusion frustums obtained from previous frames.
summary: Occlusion Frustums is an empty space skipping optimization for volume raycasting that generates simple pyramidal proxy geometry on-the-fly from a first-hit image, avoiding complex preprocessing and reprojection.
